sources.title: Burgess2024 NIST TN2279 Self-Diffusion and Binary-Diffusion Coefficients in Gases
sources.access: Official web-tool extracted text read; both local PDF downloads HTTP403. No PDF cache or visible screenshot is claimed.
sources.table_location: Printed p8 Table1a (PDF page13); reverse/duplicate entries in Table1c are not independent evidence.
sources.composition: Not stated row-by-row in TN2279; do not invent 50/50 or water partial pressure. Binary dilute-gas coefficient, not porous effective diffusivity.
sources.uncertainty: Table calls U expanded uncertainty; no uniform k or confidence level supplied. Values are not assigned as full-temperature statistical bands.
sources.rounding: Dref and A/B/C printed to three decimal places; no source rounding probability or rounding-error bound specified. Dref and full-range A/B/C are separate fits; do not require exact agreement.

N2_H2O.underlying_source_identity: Hellmann2019 H2O+N2 first-principles calculations; same underlying ordinary-water theory as S3, not an independent experiment.

N2_CO2.underlying_source_identity: Vogel/Bich/Hellmann2023 binary D inferred using kinetic theory from experimental viscosity; not a direct diffusion measurement. Literal table values retained without correction or identifying source/model as ground truth.

sources.title: Marrero and Mason1972 Gaseous Diffusion Coefficients, JPCRD1:3-118
sources.access: Web reports117 pages but0 extracted lines; screenshot yielded no visible pixels. Publisher/DOI text unavailable. Bibliography only.
sources.rejection: Original rows, units, composition, T/P, mutual/tracer and uncertainty were not directly read. Conflicting secondary water-air/water-N2 indexing is not data.

sources.title: Hellmann and Harvey2020 First-Principles Diffusivity Ratios for Kinetic Isotope Fractionation of Water in Air
sources.location: Author manuscript p4 water dilution/low-density definition; p5 TableS2 description; published Data Availability links same NIST dataset. DAT header and direct numbered lines are numeric evidence; supporting PDF itself was not read.
sources.quantity: Infinite-water-dilution binary diffusivity in N2 or O2, low-density rho_m*D normalized to finite standard total pressure. Not self diffusivity, not isotopologue ratio, not porous effective D.
sources.uncertainty_note: No absolute-D uncertainty column or uniform absolute-D bound in read text. The k2/95% estimates are for isotopologue ratios, not these D values; Merlivat1.6% is another N2 experiment. Neither transferred.
sources.rounding: Retain literal DAT decimal tokens; last shown decimal is reporting precision, not uncertainty or an assumed half-unit interval.
sources.source_dependence: Ordinary H2O values250–2000K explicitly reuse author earlier N2/O2 work. S1/S3 N2 values are related theory, not independent validation. Air column not used as either binary pair.
sources.access: DAT downloaded once1441bytes; Readme timed out once and not read; main manuscript/publisher read through web. No full PDF cache claimed.

source_3_selection_amendment: Initial local search declaration reserved a measurement paper; final selected source is original calculation with explicit independent N2/O2 columns. User allowed original papers. This is an explicit pre-evaluation design amendment, not a promotion to measured.
